sentences.en: I tremble with fear at the thought of an injection.
sentences.zh: 一想到打针我就吓得发抖。

sentences.en: He stood up with his hands trembling in a rage.
sentences.zh: 他站起来时双手因愤怒而颤抖。

sentences.en: The mere idea of swimming across the river made me tremble.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是想到要游过那条河就让我感到害怕，浑身发抖。

senses.zh: 使挥动；用颤抖的声音说出 -
